# Rails Admin Scaffold

> A Claude Code skill that generates full-featured CRUD admin panels for Rails 6.1+ applications.

## Overview

This is a template-based code generation skill invoked via `/rails-admin-scaffold` command in Claude Code. It auto-detects project configuration (CSS framework, pagination gem, test framework) and generates controllers, views, routes, and tests for admin CRUD operations.

## Key Files

- SKILL.md: Main skill definition with 5-phase generation workflow
- README.md: User documentation and installation guide
- templates/: ERB and Ruby templates for generated code
- css/: Framework-specific class mappings (Tailwind, Bootstrap, Bulma)
- reference/: Pattern documentation and field type mappings

## Architecture

Templates use placeholders ({NAMESPACE}, {MODEL}, {CSS: class-name}) replaced during generation. The workflow consists of: Detection → Model Analysis → Interactive Questions → Generation → Verification.

## Supported Features

- Ransack-powered search and filtering
- Pagination (Pagy, Kaminari, will_paginate)
- CSV/Excel export
- Bulk actions
- Soft delete support (Paranoia, Discard)
- Authentication (Devise, HTTP Basic, custom)
- i18n support
- RSpec/Minitest test generation
